collection: City of El Cerrito standalone finance reference documents
notes: Reference collection separate from the meeting-document manifests and parser artifacts. SHA-256 and byte counts cover preserved PDFs and derived searchable text. Dates on undated snapshot filenames indicate retrieval, not enactment. Public records retain source rights status. Enacted ordinance scans use unmodified official portal PDF exports. Interim State Auditor assessments are retained as an original HTML snapshot. City-authored corrective-action submissions are separately identified.

documents.title: Local Government High Risk Audit Program - City of El Cerrito: letter requesting approval of an audit
documents.publisher: California State Auditor; published by the Joint Legislative Audit Committee
documents.author: Elaine M. Howle, California State Auditor
documents.recipient: Rudy Salas, Chairman, Joint Legislative Audit Committee
documents.notes: Legislature-published redacted copy: signature is obscured in the source. Existing text layer has recognition errors, including in El Cerrito and numbers; verify quotations and figures against the scan. Describes October 2019 screening and requests an audit; not the completed 2021 audit.

text_copies.scope: Complete PDF text, including blank pages and all attachments.

documents.title: City of El Cerrito: Excessive Spending and Insufficient Efforts to Address Its Perilous Financial Condition Jeopardize the City's Ongoing Fiscal Viability
documents.notes: Complete 64-page report, including public letter on physical PDF page 3, risk summary on page 5, City response on pages 45-60, and auditor comments on pages 61-64. Printed page numbers differ from physical PDF page numbers.

text_copies.scope: Complete PDF text, including blank pages and all attachments.
Public transmittal letter only; full findings, City response, and auditor comments are in the full report.

documents.title: Local High Risk Program: The State Auditor Is Removing Its High-Risk Designation From Four Cities and Retaining the Designation for Three Others
documents.notes: Complete 85-page multi-city follow-up. Public letter on physical PDF page 3 removes El Cerrito high-risk designation. El Cerrito assessment on physical pages 11-15 (printed pages 5-9) rates four risk areas fully addressed and ongoing-cost reductions partially addressed.

text_copies.scope: Complete PDF text, including blank pages and all attachments.
Public transmittal letter and complete El Cerrito assessment, printed pages 5-9; intervening pages and other cities omitted. Includes Figure 1 text, but not its graphical layout.
